## Publish Survey (PS)

The single writer for a survey’s publish event: requires a title and ≥1 question, then stamps `publishedAt` exactly once (added to the shared Survey block additively; `isPublished` derives from it, so the boolean can never drift).

### Example

Natural target: the linked Onboarding Feedback survey (already published — re-running demonstrates the once-only guard).

### Non-goals

No unpublish (responses may reference the published form; retiring is a different concern). No distribution — publication states availability, delivery is out of scope.

cardInfo.summary: Stamps publishedAt once after checking the survey is actually publishable.
